title: Kamishiro Rui — Troubled At Midnight〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: As I just mentioned, you becoming freelancers poses many problems for us.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: However, we're also not in a position to force you to stay on your current contracts.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
We'll consider your proposal...
Let us hope that it works out for both parties in the end.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We weren't able to reach a resolution, but our discussion still ended up being quite worthwhile.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Especially since they agreed to allow me to invite Emu on this endeavor.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But whether or not she agrees is ultimately up to her.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: When the time comes for them to say that they wish to leave the Wonder Stage, will you try to follow in their footsteps?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nope.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because my dream is to protect Grandpa's amusement park and keep it the way it is.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And make a place where everyone smiles!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Emu deeply cares about Phoenix Wonderland, from the bottom of her heart...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I shouldn't get in the way of her dream...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But I...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I want the four of us to make our dreams come true together. I don't want to give up on that...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What am I supposed to do in this situation...?
Huh? Rui...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Are you heading back to the Wonder Stage?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We thought you were gonna go straight home after you took care of that thing you were talking about. I just said bye to the others after finishing up practice and...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(I'm at Phoenix Wonderland...?
But why? I thought I was on my way home...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(This isn't good...
I can't seem to get the conversation I had with her brothers out of my mind.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've finished doing that thing I mentioned, but I got the feeling I'd left something here.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Want me to help you look?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, thank you. I should be fine.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu, there's something I'd like to ask you...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sure, what's up?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Would it be possible for us to talk tomorrow...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tomorrow? Not now...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
This matter also involves Tsukasa and Nene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, I'd like to discuss it when we're all present.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, got it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll let you know once I have a better idea of when we can all meet. For now, see you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: See you then♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My hope is that I'll get the same sort of positive response tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I can't bring myself to give up being with them.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I've finally found the best of friends in Tsukasa, Nene and Emu.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So, I'm going to spend every second I have left to think of a way for us to stay together while pursuing our dreams.)
